definitions.gloss: to accomplish, to achieve, to carry through to completion
definitions.explanation: To successfully complete a difficult or significant undertaking. Emphasizes the completion of something that required sustained effort or determination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成|な}し{遂|と}げた。
⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成|な}し{遂|と}げる⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めない→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: I won't give up until I achieve my goal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}え→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成|な}し{遂|と}げた。
examples.english: Overcoming difficulties, the team brilliantly completed the project.

notes:
{成|な}し{遂|と}げる is a compound verb combining {成|な}す (to accomplish, to form) and ⟦{遂|と}げる→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧ (to carry through to the end).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成|な}し{遂|と}げる

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偉業|いぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成|な}し{遂|と}げる: to accomplish a great feat
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成|な}し{遂|と}げる: to achieve a goal
- ⟦{使命|しめい}→使命：11445_shimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成|な}し{遂|と}げる: to fulfill a mission
- ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成|な}し{遂|と}げる: to carry out a reform

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {成|な}し{遂|と}げる: to accomplish (emphasizes completion of something significant)
- ⟦{達成|たっせい}する→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧: to achieve, to attain (more neutral, common in business)
- ⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to fulfill, to carry out (duty or promise)
- ⟦やり{遂|と}げる→やり遂げる：16745_yaritogeru⟧: to see through to the end (more colloquial)
